name: Comment box
what: A comment bar rises in at the bottom, a word types itself into the field with a blinking caret, the send arrow is tapped and the comment posts as a bubble just above the bar; a heart pops on it with a burst of dots and a like count, then beats gently.
origin: A MotionLab original for a common need (a viewer comment typed and posted over a talking head), rebuilt in our HyperFrames way from the look and motion of an MIT-licensed Python effect (claude-video-effects, comment-box / comment_bar); 2026-10-27
motion: f0-f14 the bar rises in from below (power3.out, fading in f0-f4); the caret blinks in the empty field (8 frames on, 8 off); from f14 the comment types in one letter every 3 frames (36 frames at most for a long one), the send button lights up with the first letter (a small pop); 6 frames after the last letter the send arrow is tapped (a 3-frame dip, back.out back, a ripple 14 f) and shoots up; 2 frames later the comment posts: a bubble rises from the field to just above the bar (expo.out 12 f, its size back.out from 0.7); 12 frames later a heart pops (to 1.3 in 5 f, back.out to 1 in 8 f) with eight dots bursting out (12 f) and the like count rises in; in the hold the heart beats twice every 36 frames, the bubble bobs 3 px and the caret blinks; at the end both drop 44 px and fade (power2.in, 8 f). With the default four letters: typing f14-f23, tap f32, post f34, heart f46.
